name: Let's Dance – The 80's Tribute Show
description: An 80s tribute show at Theatre on the Steps, Bridgnorth.

name: ICAN2 Creative Art Sessions (Monday) – 14 September
description: Low-cost Monday creative-art session run by 4 All Foundation. Recurs Mondays 16:30–18:30. The organiser states that 1-to-1 spaces are available and pre-booking is essential via its online booking system.
accessibility: 1-to-1 spaces are available; contact/book through the organiser for details.

name: Marches Youth Club – 18 September
description: Free Friday youth club at The Marches School with multisports, games, arts/crafts, baking and more. The organiser says spaces are limited and booking is essential. Recurs on Fridays; no end date is stated.

name: Halloween Half-Term free crafts at Shrewsbury Flaxmill Maltings
description: Free drop-in Halloween craft sessions run 10:00–14:00 on Thursday 29, Friday 30 and Saturday 31 October 2026. Suitable for ages 2–12, with older siblings welcome; children must be accompanied by an adult. No admission purchase or booking is needed for the free crafts. A separate Rat Trail runs 24 October–1 November with usual exhibition prices.
age_guidance: Ages 2–12; older siblings welcome; children accompanied by an adult

name: Battle of the Bands – Heat Two
description: Heat Two of Albert's Shed's grassroots Battle of the Bands competition.

name: Good Habits – The Hive
description: Good Habits live at The Hive. Official listing states doors 7pm, support from 7:30pm and Good Habits at 8:20pm.

name: Oswestry Library Storytime – 16 September
description: Free weekly story and rhyme session for pre-school children at Oswestry Library. No booking needed: just drop in. Current confirmed Wednesday dates run 16, 23 and 30 September, then 7, 14, 21 and 28 October 2026, 10:30–11:00.

name: Outdoor Tour: Introduction to Attingham – 16 September
description: Free 30-minute outdoor introductory tour exploring the family and fortune of Attingham Park. Normal National Trust admission charges apply to non-members; booking is not needed.
accessibility: The walk uses a variety of surfaces and may include uneven, loose ground.

name: Arleston Youth Club – 14 September
description: Free weekly Monday youth club run by 4 All Foundation, with multi-sports, arts and crafts and other activities. Recurs Mondays 16:30–18:30. Booking requirement is not stated.

name: Exhibition on Screen: James McNeill Whistler
description: Exhibition on Screen film made in collaboration with Tate Britain, exploring James McNeill Whistler and his influence.

name: Shrewsbury Library Rhyme Time (morning) – 14 September
description: Free rhyme-and-song session for children up to five and their parents/carers. This morning session recurs on Mondays; the official listing confirms 14, 21 and 28 September and 5, 12, 19 and 26 October 2026. Booking requirements are not stated.

name: Tom Thorp & ILUMETRIS – The Hive
description: Tom Thorp & ILUMETRIS present a multimedia jazz show at The Hive. Official listing states doors 6:30pm for a 7pm start; £25 standard and £12 under-22.

name: Ellesmere Youth Club – 14 September
description: Free weekly Monday youth club with sports, games, arts/crafts and more. Recurs Mondays 17:30–19:30 at Ellesmere Town Hall. Booking requirement is not stated.

name: Ghost Walk 2026 – Bridgnorth – 26 October
description: An hour-long walking tour through historic Bridgnorth meeting characters from local ghost stories, followed by a short cabaret at Theatre on the Steps.
accessibility: Walking route includes hills and steps and is not recommended for anyone with mobility issues. Sensible shoes and a torch are recommended.

name: Shrewsbury Flea – Antique & Collectors Fair – 10 October
description: Shrewsbury Flea antique and collectors fair at West Mid Showground. Public admission starts at 8am; entry is £4 per person. Cash is accepted at the gate, while card users are advised to pre-book.
accessibility: The organiser states that the venue is wheelchair accessible, all buildings are accessible, and disabled toilets are available. Accessible parking spaces are limited.
parking_transport: Free parking is available on site.

name: Aladdinsane – Bowie Tribute – 24 October
description: Second Bridgnorth performance of Aladdinsane, the Bowie tribute show.

name: Shrewsbury Town Ghost Tours 2026 – 1 October
description: Guided ghost tour around Shrewsbury town exploring local history and ghost stories. The official listing runs from 1 to 22 October; this record represents the first confirmed occurrence.

name: Oswestry Apple Day – 3 October
description: Annual Oswestry Apple Day celebrating apples and healthy eating, with interesting apple varieties and growing advice from local orchard group CROP.

name: Ben Creighton Griffiths – Jazz Harp Trio
description: Jazz harpist Ben Creighton Griffiths performs with Benedict Stephens on bass and Joseph Van Parys on guitar.

name: Aladdinsane – Bowie Tribute – 23 October
description: Aladdinsane presents the sound and vision of David Bowie at Theatre on the Steps.

name: Belinda O’Hooley – Hermon Arts
description: Acclaimed pianist, singer, songwriter and composer Belinda O’Hooley performs at Hermon Chapel.

name: SPACE – Ten Neurotic Fairytales Tour 2026
description: SPACE bring their Ten Neurotic Fairytales Tour 2026 to Albert's Shed Shrewsbury. Official venue listing gives doors at 7:30pm and links to ticket sales.

name: Audio Thieves – Albert's Shed Southwater
description: Audio Thieves live at Albert's Shed Southwater. Official venue listing states free entry before 9pm and £5 general admission after 9pm.

name: Like Combs UK – The Ultimate Luke Combs Tribute
description: Full-band Luke Combs tribute celebrating the country star's best-known songs.

name: Autumn Half Term at Dudmaston Hall
description: Family autumn spotter activity on listed open dates from 25 October to 1 November 2026, generally 11:00–16:00. Free autumn crafts run 11:00–14:00 on 25 October, 31 October and 1 November. The event is free but normal venue admission applies. Booking is not needed. Parts of the trail are outdoors.
accessibility: A PMV may be available to borrow; contact Dudmaston in advance to enquire.
age_guidance: Suitable for children; exact ages not stated

name: Talking Horses + Headcase – Albert's Shed Shrewsbury
description: Talking Horses and Headcase live at Albert's Shed Shrewsbury. Official venue listing states free entry before 10pm; the £5 after-10pm ticket option is currently shown as sold out.

name: Blue Lantern Session: Robert Vincent with Anna Corcoran
description: Blue Lantern Session featuring Americana and roots singer-songwriter Robert Vincent with Anna Corcoran.

name: Dar Williams + Heather Maloney – The Hive
description: Dar Williams performs at The Hive with support from Heather Maloney. Official listing states doors 7pm and the gig starts 7:45pm.

name: Celebrating Summer – Susan Mulcock – Willow Gallery
description: Two-day wet-felting workshop with Susan Mulcock, 10am–4pm on both Saturday and Sunday. Participants explore summer landscapes, perspective, scale and texture. Materials are included and the workshop is suitable for all levels of ability and experience.

name: Wildlings – The Cut Visitor Centre – 16 September
description: Weekly outdoor nature-play session for young children and grown-ups, with den building, puddles, minibeast hunting, mud play and other guided outdoor activities. Current advertised Wednesday dates include 16, 23 and 30 September, then 7, 14 and 21 October 2026, 10:30–12:00. £6.50 first child, £3.50 additional siblings plus booking fee; babies in arms are free when accompanying an older sibling. Individual advance booking is available; limited on-the-day places may be available.
accessibility: The Cut Visitor Centre has wheelchair access through both entrances, flat surfaced gardens, an accessible toilet and baby-changing facilities. Wildlings is an outdoor, all-weather activity and suitable clothing/footwear is advised.
parking_transport: Abbey Foregate pay-and-display parking nearby; limited short-term spaces are available outside The Cut.
age_guidance: Most suited to 18 months–5 years; babies in arms free with older sibling

name: Art Society Teme Valley: Strong Liquors and High Kickers
description: Professor Jonathan Conlin explores the Anglo-French exchange behind the creation and history of the can-can. Visitors are welcome at £8 on the door; members are free.

name: Sara Colman & Rebecca Nash – Joni Mitchell Reimagined and Ribbons
description: Sara Colman and Rebecca Nash, joined by Henrik Jensen, perform reimagined Joni Mitchell songs alongside material from the 2026 album Ribbons Vol.1.

name: Behind the Scenes at Shropshire Archives – 10:15 tour
description: Free Heritage Open Day behind-the-scenes tour of Shropshire Archives, including store rooms and a display of documents celebrating everyday histories.
accessibility: Store rooms are on different levels; a lift is available.

name: Behind the Scenes at Shropshire Archives – 11:30 tour
description: Second free Heritage Open Day behind-the-scenes tour of Shropshire Archives.
accessibility: Store rooms are on different levels; a lift is available.

name: Shropshire Health Visiting Open Access Clinic – Bridgnorth – 6 October
description: Free, no-appointment health visiting drop-in offering health advice, information and support for parents/carers and their baby or child. Runs on the first two Tuesdays of each month at Bridgnorth Library, 13:30–16:00. Current confirmed dates include 6 and 13 October, 3 and 10 November, and 1 and 8 December 2026.
age_guidance: Parents/carers with babies or children; exact child age limit not stated

name: Ditherington Stay and Play – 16 September
description: Low-cost stay-and-play group for babies and toddlers. Wednesdays 09:30–10:30 during term time only. Booking requirement is not stated.

name: Battle of the Bands – Heat One
description: Heat One of Albert's Shed's Battle of the Bands competition for emerging original bands from Telford and the surrounding area.

name: Mansion Highlight Tour – BSL Interpreted – Attingham Park
description: BSL-interpreted guided highlight tour of Attingham Park Mansion's Ground Floor. The event ticket is free but normal Attingham admission applies. Booking is essential, with a maximum of eight people; bookings close at 08:00 on the day. Children are welcome when accompanied by an adult.
accessibility: BSL interpreted. Important access limitation: there is no level access to the Mansion Ground Floor. The nearest toilets are in the West Pavilion; contact Attingham for individual access queries.
parking_transport: Designated blue-badge parking is available at Attingham Park. The Mansion is about a 10–15 minute walk from Visitor Reception; arrive at least 15 minutes before the tour.
age_guidance: Children welcome with an adult; no minimum age stated

name: Third Class: A Titanic Story
description: A one-man play based on Titanic survivor Edward Dorking, followed by a live Q&A. Official venue listing gives £15 standard and £13.50 concession.

name: Blackadder Goes Forth – Theatre on the Steps
description: Theatre on the Steps presents Blackadder Goes Forth from 8–17 October 2026. This record uses the first performance date; multiple performances are listed on the official booking page.

name: Ditherington Youth Club – 16 September
description: Free youth club run by 4 All Foundation in partnership with Young Shrewsbury. Wednesdays 18:30–20:30 during term time only. Activities include dodgeball, football, cooking, tile painting and games. The page offers online booking but does not state that booking is essential.

name: Piano Duet Recital – Hermon Arts
description: Simone Damiani and Arthur Bocaneanu perform piano duets including works by Bartók and Schubert in Hermon Chapel's final Sunday afternoon recital of the summer.

name: Pumpkinfest – Park Hall Farm – 2 October
description: Family Halloween event with a pumpkin for every paying child to carve and take home, plus Pumpkin Alley, The Little Scare House, a Spooky Trail, games and Park Hall's usual farm, animal, indoor and outdoor play activities. Runs 10:00–17:00 on 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 16, 17 and 18 October, then daily 23 October–1 November 2026. Online adult/child 2–16 price £14.95; onsite £16.95; under-2s free.
age_guidance: Family event; child ticket 2–16, under-2s free

name: Ghost Walk 2026 – Bridgnorth – 27 October
